content:
incident-bot: Pager alert at 2026-11-02T19:02:03Z — elevated webhook delivery failures for Stripe integrations. Observed surge of 429 and 402 responses on event replay endpoints. Impact: billing-sync backfill and webhook consumers. Paging @jordan (oncall). Severity: P1. https://status.stripe.com/ (live)

jordan (oncall): ack — joining bridge. grabbing logs now.

jordan (oncall): quick snapshot from webhook-ingest-prod logs:
```
[19:01:58] POST /webhooks/stripe 500 - downstream error
[19:02:00] stripe-api: 429 Too Many Requests {"error": "quota_exceeded", "message":"quota enforced for account"}
[19:02:12] replay-job: failed to ack event evt_1Jx... 402 Payment Required
```

maya (payments): seeing increased retries from our replay worker — looks like Stripe is returning a mix of 429/rate_limit and 402 indicating account-level enforcement. Customer entitlements not updating for some accounts, so customers get locked out of paid features.

tara (cs): have we identified which customers? a couple of enterprise customers already pinged support, saying billing status is stale.

sam (sre): root cause likely Stripe throttling our API tokens for event_replay or list-events due to bursty replay traffic. Two mitigations we should consider now:
- enable polling fallback (start list-events poller to slow-catch missed events)
- reduce webhook concurrency + backoff to avoid further quota hits
- open/upgrade ticket with Stripe support

jordan (oncall): agreed. maya, can you open/up the Stripe ticket and ask for temporary quota relaxation? include request-id headers and sample timestamps.

maya (payments): opened ticket with Stripe: https://support.stripe.com/ticket/CH-98765. Request: temporary quota increase for account shard + guidance on idempotency. Stripe assigned engineer; they replied: "We're seeing account-level rate enforcement due to high replay rate. Recommend reducing concurrency and using list events with pagination and idempotency. We can provide a temporary allowance after investigation."

ops-bot: Action created: ops/stripe/polling-fallback -> start-poller (owner: jordan)

jordan (oncall): starting polling fallback now. Command to flip feature flag:
```
# enable polling fallback (feature flag)
./infra/flags set billing.polling_fallback true --env=prod
# start poller service
sudo systemctl start stripe-poller.service
```

sam (sre): I reduced webhook ingestion workers from 40 -> 8 to reduce concurrent calls to Stripe, and increased retry backoff (exponential cap -> 30s). Pushing config now.

jordan (oncall): poller started. initial headcount: 0 -> replaying. Running with page size=100 and 1 QPS to Stripe per region to be conservative.

maya (payments): adding protective measures on entitlement checks: temporarily treat missing billing-sync as "grace" for 1 hour for customers in affected SKUs. Tara, please coordinate CS message and grace flags.

tara (cs): will prepare notification and mark impacted customers in support UI. Draft message: "We're currently replaying billing updates; we've applied a temporary billing grace so you won't lose access while we catch up." I'll wait until we have rough ETA.

stripe-support-bot: Stripe update: "Investigating enforcement triggered by high replay rates. We've identified burst coming from your account's replay worker. Recommend de-duplicating replays and spacing requests. We will provision a short-term allowance — ETA 30-60 minutes."

jordan (oncall): replay progress: started at 19:05Z. backlog size ~ 24k events. Poller throughput ~ 180 events/min initially. ETA rough: ~2 hours at conservative rate. Monitoring queue depth.

sam (sre): adding temporary metric alert to detect any further 4xx spike to stop poller if Stripe asks us to throttle more.

maya (payments): re: customer-facing billing delays: affected customers count ~ 12 (enterprise + small set of high-volume). We're drafting individual notes for high-value accounts.

ops-bot: checkpoint saved: ops/stripe/state -> {"poller":"running","workers":8,"stripe_ticket":"CH-98765"}

jordan (oncall): Stripe engineer DM: "We've opened backend remediation and lifted a small amount of quota; please keep request rate steady. We'll confirm when fully resolved." They asked for request-id header samples, which I posted in the ticket.

maya (payments): starting controlled catchup to avoid re-triggering enforcement. Poller now set to 2 QPS across regions, with idempotency keys for each event.

jordan (oncall): replay is ramping, we've processed ~6k events in first 30m. No new 429 spikes observed since concurrency reduction. Good sign.

tara (cs): sending proactive note to impacted customers now. noting the temporary grace and that we will follow up when billing sync completes.

stripe-support-bot: Stripe update: "We see reduced contention after your throttling changes. We'll continue monitoring; will follow up with full root cause once finished."

jordan (oncall): status update for the channel: mitigation in place — polling fallback active, webhook concurrency reduced, Stripe engaged. Impact: billing-sync delay causing some customers to not see immediate entitlement updates but no forced cancellations. Severity remains P2 for now; we'll keep ticket open until backlog drained and Stripe confirms.

maya (payments): started catchup job on replay-processor to idempotently apply missing invoices/charges. Monitoring for duplicate application.

sam (sre): adding a post-incident task: introduce graceful replay pacing and adaptive backoff if Stripe returns 4xx quota errors. Also add observability: expose stripe-request-id tag in logs and dashboards.

jordan (oncall): handoff: I'll stay online for the next 30m; then handing to morning follow team. Last ETA check: backlog down to ~9k events, processing ~220 events/min. If anything spikes, page @sam and @maya.

tara (cs): logged support cases for the 12 affected customers and included the temporary grace note. will follow up with status updates every hour.

stripe-support-bot: Final note from Stripe: "We applied temporary quota relief; recommend you implement replay pacing and reduce concurrency. We're closing our immediate mitigation conversation but will respond to follow-up ticket CH-98765 for RCA." 

jordan (oncall): marking incident as mitigated for now. I'll write an incident summary and action items. Leaving ticket open to verify full backlog drain and Stripe RCA. Handoff to @sam (sre) for follow-up and to @maya for customer comms.

sam (sre): ack. I'll own the post-incident checklist and add the adaptive pacing change to next sprint.

maya (payments): ack — will follow up with account teams for any remaining customer outreach.

ops-bot: Incident state -> mitigated (partial). Follow-ups: 1) adaptive pacing, 2) stripe-request-id in logs, 3) replay idempotency audit.

jordan (oncall): thanks team. Closing thread after I upload the short postmortem.
